name: Chlorobenzene
aliases: MCB, benzene chloride, chloranylbenzene, monochlorobenzene, PhCl, phenyl chloride
summary: Chlorobenzene (abbreviated PhCl) is an aryl chloride and the simplest of the chlorobenzenes, consisting of a benzene ring substituted with one chlorine atom. Its chemical formula is C6H5Cl. This colorless, flammable liquid is a common solvent and a widely used intermediate in the manufacture of other chemicals.
